front.title: PQC Key Provenance Evidence for RATS Attestation

abstract.t: This document defines PQC key provenance evidence claims for use within the RATS (Remote ATtestation procedureS) architecture (RFC 9334). It specifies Evidence claim formats that attest to the PQC algorithm capabilities, current epoch_id, and key provenance of an attesting environment, enabling Verifiers to enforce PQC readiness requirements as part of appraisal policy.
This revision (-03) adds conformance criteria for hybrid key attestation, aligns claim formats with FIPS 204/205, and introduces a SCITT receipt binding for attested epoch transitions.

note.title: IPR Considerations
note.t: U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/080,137 (2026-06-01) and U.S. Patent Application No. 19/698,870 (2026-06-05). Sanctum SecOps PEN root: 1.3.6.1.4.1.65953.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: The RATS architecture defines a framework for remotely attesting the trustworthiness of an Attesting Environment. As deployments migrate to PQC, Verifiers require assurance that Attesters are operating with PQC-capable signing keys at a known, current epoch. This document defines RATS Evidence claims that convey PQC key provenance, algorithm identity, and epoch currency to Verifiers.

section.name: Terminology
section.t: BCP 14 applies. Terms from RFC 9334 apply.

dl.dd: RATS Evidence claims asserting the algorithm identity, epoch_id, and generation provenance of an Attesting Environment's active signing key.
Monotonically increasing integer identifying the current PQC key epoch, consistent with draft-vicente-lamps-rotation-envelope.

section.name: PQC Evidence Claim Definitions
section.t: The following claims are defined for inclusion in RATS Evidence (EAT or CBOR-encoded):

dl.dd: Text string. The algorithm identifier (OID or COSE algorithm label) of the active PQC signing key. MUST be present in PQC-capable Attesters.
Uint. The current epoch_id of the active PQC signing key. MUST be non-zero.
Text string (enumerated). One of: "hardware-tpm", "hardware-hsm", "software-fips", "software-other". Indicates the generation and storage environment of the active key.
Boolean. TRUE if the active signing key is a hybrid composite (PQC + classical). FALSE if pure PQC.
Bytes. Optional. A SCITT transparency receipt binding the epoch_id to a published Rotation Envelope (draft-vicente-scitt-pqc-transparency-receipts).

section.t: Verifiers enforcing a PQC readiness appraisal policy MUST reject Evidence where pqc-alg-id indicates a classical-only algorithm. Verifiers SHOULD reject Evidence where pqc-epoch-id is lower than the minimum acceptable epoch for the deployment.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: PQC Evidence claims MUST be integrity-protected by the Attester's active ML-DSA signing key. A compromised classical signing key MUST NOT be used to sign PQC Evidence claims; doing so would defeat the purpose of PQC attestation. Verifiers MUST validate the signing algorithm of the Evidence envelope itself before trusting any contained PQC claims.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: IANA is requested to register the claim names defined in this document in the IANA RATS Entity Attestation Token (EAT) registry and the CBOR Web Token (CWT) Claims registry.
